subject: Collaborative MAP framework + starter slides (compact timeline)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina@probe-ai.com>, Elliot Park <elliot.park@probe-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Collaborative MAP framework + starter slides (compact timeline)

Hi Lina / Elliot —

Nice to meet you on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I wanted to share a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) starter so we can align on a 4–6 week evaluation that keeps your infra team unblocked and gives ProbeAI the ability to validate inference cost and latency on a representative subset of traffic.

Attached: ProbeAI_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (starter draft) and MAP-starter-slides-v1.gslides (1-slide summary for execs). Key points below:

- Week 0: kickoff + engineering discovery (reqs, sample payloads, security checklist)
- Week 1–2: sandbox integration + smoke tests; measure baseline latency/cost
- Week 3–4: pilot runs on 10–20k requests/day; iterate prompts and batching
- Week 5: acceptance run and handoff doc (acceptance criteria: 95th-pct latency <= X ms; token cost within agreed target)

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the reviewers and their availability for a 30–45m kickoff next week?
2) Any must-have security/SCIM/KMS constraints we should add to Week 0?
3) Do you prefer the compact timeline above or a more stretched 8–10 week pilot (we can expand milestones)?

Next steps: if we get your reviewer list today I will send a calendar invite + a first-draft MAP gdoc with inline owners. I’ve put Marissa on edits and Jasmine on acceptance criteria so we can iterate fast.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- ProbeAI_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)
- MAP-starter-slides-v1.gslides (Google Slides)
From: Lina Ortiz <lina@probe-ai.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP framework + starter slides (compact timeline)

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Reviewers: Elliot (infra), Priya S. (security lead, priya.s@probe-ai.com), and our PM Lina (me). I’ll loop Priya on the kickoff invite.
- Security: we need to confirm KMS flow (we're HSM-backed for secrets) and a timeline for SOC-2 artifact review.
- Timeline: compact 6-week looks good. We’re targeting a product review on 7/30, so shorter is better.

Can we kick off next Tuesday 6/30 or Wednesday 7/1 mornings (ET)? I prefer Tuesday 10–11am ET.

Lina
Head of Product
ProbeAI

Neha — I made a few quick edits in the gdoc and added an "Acceptance checklist" section under Week 5. High-level changes:

- Added explicit SLIs: 95th-pct latency target, error-rate threshold, and token-cost target (draft numbers included).
- Added owner assignments for Week 1 integration tasks (Elliot for infra contact; Marissa for Redwood test harness).
- Inserted a short runbook for rollbacks if latency spikes >2x baseline during pilot.

Inline comment to discuss: security artifact timing — we should offer a temporary NDA + SOC-2 evidence share before Week 1 if Priya requests it.
